documents.title: Onboarding Guide
documents.content: Swizzle runs local automations through stdin, stdout, and environment variables. This guide explains how new teammates validate, run, and deploy an automation package in a repeatable way.

documents.title: Incident Playbook
documents.content: When a run fails repeatedly, inspect the latest attempts, look at stderr logs, confirm required secrets exist, and rerun with a sample payload before shipping another deployment.
